Short title, extent and commencement

NORTHERN AREAS ANTI-TERRORISM ORDER, 2000
NORTHERN AREAS
ANTI-TERRORISM ORDER, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 19th July, 2000]
S.R.0.496(I)/2000, dated
11-7-2000.--An Order to extend and apply the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997, to
Northern Areas;
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Order may be called
the Northern Areas Anti-Terrorism Order, 2000.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Northern Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Adaptation and enforcement of the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997 (XXVII of 1997)

NORTHERN AREAS ANTI-TERRORISM ORDER, 2000
NORTHERN AREAS
ANTI-TERRORISM ORDER, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 19th July, 2000]
S.R.0.496(I)/2000, dated
11-7-2000.--An Order to extend and apply the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997, to
Northern Areas;
2. Adaptation and enforcement
of the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997 (XXVII
of 1997).--The Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997 (XXVII of 1997), as in force in
Pakistan immediately before the commencement of this Order, and all rules,
notification and order issued thereunder are adapted and shall, as far as
practicable, apply and be in force in the Northern Areas subject to the
modifications and in its application shall have effect as if reference
therein---
(a) to "Provincial
Government" were a reference to the Government of Northern Areas;
(b) to "High Court"
were a reference to the "Chief Court Northern areas"; and
(c) to "Chief Justice"
were a reference to "the Chairman, Chief Court Northern Areas".
